prompt.en: A station's VOX starts transmitting when a fan turns on across the room. Which adjustment area best matches the symptom?

text.en: The VOX sensitivity and delay settings

explanation.en: VOX keys from detected audio, so accidental transmit from room noise calls for VOX sensitivity and timing adjustments.

prompt.en: A digital-mode signal decodes locally but shows extra side traces on a nearby waterfall display. What is the clean-signal fix?

text.en: Raise computer audio until ALC is always active
Reduce sound-card/interface drive and recheck for splatter
Switch the receiver to a wider filter
Add more receive DSP noise reduction

explanation.en: Extra traces beside the wanted digital signal are an overdrive clue; backing down transmit audio is the right first correction.

prompt.en: A packet station hears a frame that requests forwarding through its callsign alias. What block-level action describes digipeater operation?

text.en: Convert the packet to analog FM speech
Reject all frames unless connected to the internet
Compress the audio for higher average SSB power

explanation.en: A digipeater is a digital relay: it forwards packets marked for retransmission, rather than changing them into analog voice.
